geometry_engine: not included; consumes zone labels and upstream geometry provenance
claim_ceiling: Synthetic FSM, dwell and gap conformance only. Does not infer line-fast, physical berth arrival, cargo operations, actual Durban AIS performance or navigation state.

clock_semantics.relation: separate clock domains; do not subtract one from the other or assume synchronization
clock_semantics.gap_rule: Candidate dwell continuity is broken if either within-clock event-time gap or within-clock receiver-time gap exceeds its independently declared threshold.

initialization_policy: INDETERMINATE by default; OUTSIDE or another non-indeterminate starting state requires a non-empty evidence reference.

event_scoring.matching_method: maximum-cardinality then minimum-total-interval-distance one-to-one bipartite matching using residual min-cost flow
event_scoring.claim_ceiling: Synthetic known-truth event scoring only; no field detection accuracy claim.
event_scoring.tie_break: deterministic for a fixed input ordering
